propositions: Single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-pass per-tier model selection across multiple providers, causing silent downgrade suppression and split-brain routing to wrong providers
Bare model names in model_ladder (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5) resolve to direct Anthropic even on Bedrock runs, routing Pass-1 finders across provider boundary

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must be resolved at three independent call sites (config.resolve_model, batch runner ladder expansion, and verifier paths) to prevent unresolved string literals reaching providers
REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE deep-merges tables (preserving sibling keys like provider and endpoint) but replaces arrays wholesale (no append mode for fallback chains)
Shallow merge via read_reserved_section must not change for non-llm reserved sections; deep merge lives only in llm config resolver to avoid altering unrelated consumers
Reserved class names in existing model-string value space resolve through single resolve_model_string function without schema change to workflow YAML
